The '''Phelarion system''' was a [[star system]] in the [[Seswenna sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and the [[Western Reaches]].<ref name="Western" /> It fell within grid square M-18 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and contained [[Phelarion]], a terrestrial astronomical object that was the site of an [[Phelarion Imperial Academy|Imperial Academy]]. Following the [[death]] of [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] at the [[Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Rise" /> many of the wealthy elite of the Imperial [[capital]], [[Coruscant]], sent their [[Youngling|children]] to the [[Imperial Academy|academy]] on Phelarion in the hope of claiming some of the honor attached to Tarkin's reputation and memory.<ref name="Rise" /> The system shared its name<ref name="Appendix" /> with the [[Phelarion School]], which was located on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]].<ref name="Servants">''[[Servants of the Empire: Rebel in the Ranks]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the Phelarion system was mentioned in "[[Star Systems of the Galaxy]]," an appendix published with the [[Star Wars Galaxy Map|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map]] on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="Appendix" /> on [[June 24]], 2025. Both were written by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Substack">{{Substack|subdomain=jasonfry|url=p/about-that-new-star-wars-galaxy-map|text=About That New Star Wars Galaxy Map…|name=[[Jason Fry]]|username=jasonfry|date=2025-06-24}}</ref> The [[Phelarion system/Legends|Phelarion system]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it appeared in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

The [[Phelarion system/Legends|system]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic strip]] "[[Princess Leia, Imperial Servant]]," which was written by [[Russ Helm]], illustrated by [[Russ Manning]], and published by the [[Los Angeles Times Syndicate]]<ref name="Leia">"[[Princess Leia, Imperial Servant]]"</ref> between [[November 6]] and [[December 31]], [[1979]].<ref name="Classics">''[[Star Wars: The Classic Newspaper Comics Vol. 1]]''</ref> It was then first identified in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by Fry and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
